tools.description: Get the full schema for an entity: field names, types, options, relationships, children, behaviors, and flow states. Call this before creating or querying to know what fields exist.
tools.name: get_schema

tools.description: Query/list records from any entity with filters, sorting, and pagination. Filter syntax: simple value match, 'ne:value' for not-equal, 'gt:N' for greater-than, 'lt:N' for less-than.
tools.name: list

tools.description: Get a single record by ID. Returns all fields, computed fields, children, and available transitions.
tools.name: get

tools.description: Create a new record. Call get_schema first to know required fields and valid options.
tools.name: create

data.description: Field values for the new record

tools.description: Update an existing record. Only send the fields you want to change.
tools.name: update

tools.description: Transition a record's state in its workflow. Follow the workflow states returned by the record schema. Use get to see available _transitions on a record.
tools.name: transition

action.description: Transition action name exactly as the flow spells it. Read it from the record's _transitions rather than guessing.

target_state.description: The state that action moves the record INTO, e.g. 'open', 'sent', 'completed'. Send both — either one resolves the transition.

tools.description: Full-text search across all entities or a specific entity.
tools.name: search

tools.description: Count records in an entity with optional filters. Faster than list when you only need the total.
tools.name: count

tools.description: Create a new record from an existing one using document chains. Use the document chain defined by the source and target schemas. Automatically maps fields from source to target.
tools.name: make_from

data.description: Fields to update on all records

tools.description: Run an aggregate report query on an entity. Supports count, sum, avg, min, max, optionally grouped by a field. Aggregates the whole matching set, not one page — always prefer this over listing records and adding them up yourself. For accounts receivable/payable or any financial statement, use financial_report instead: it returns the same figures as the UI.
tools.name: report

aggregate.description: Operation: count, sum, avg, min, max

group_by.description: Optional: group results by this field

tools.description: Run a canonical accounting report — the same figures the dashboard and report screens show. Use this for receivables, payables, and the financial statements rather than summing invoices or bills yourself. Reports: ar_aging (accounts receivable / total outstanding by customer), ap_aging (accounts payable by vendor, incl. MSME 45-day exposure), balance_sheet, profit_and_loss, trial_balance, cash_flow, dashboard_summary (headline totals). The 'headline' field carries the top-line figure; do not re-add the buckets yourself.
tools.name: financial_report

as_of.description: YYYY-MM-DD; aging and balance sheet. Defaults to today.

book_id.description: Optional accounting book id. Defaults to Primary (with legacy history).

from_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; P&L, trial balance, cash flow. Defaults to the fiscal year.

to_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; P&L, trial balance, cash flow.

view.description: Optional book view: primary (default), delta (one adjustment's deltas), adjusted (Primary + one adjustment), inventory (company-wide diagnostic).
